answers.explanation: Routers, switches, access points, and cameras run firmware that needs updates too.
Priorities are resourcefulness. The others are robustness.
If the contacts live only on the file server that's down, you can't call anyone.
People can be single points of failure too. Train at least two.
Segmentation and least access help the system withstand attack.
Fail closed: a crashed firewall blocks, rather than lets everything through.
Everything else depends on the network being able to move packets safely.
The assignment asks how you address robustness and resourcefulness, including anything you've already done.
